coverage_semantics: Detection-observed only; no confirmed zero-detection periods are generated.

processing_parameters.timestamp: FIRMS acquisition date + HHMM interpreted as UTC; original values retained
processing_parameters.coordinates: latitude [-90,90], longitude [-180,180]; invalid rows retained in invalid_observations
processing_parameters.confidence: native field retained; UI bands are a display convention, not calibrated cross-sensor confidence
processing_parameters.brightness: MODIS brightness/bright_t31 and VIIRS bright_ti4/bright_ti5 remain separate
processing_parameters.duplicate_identity: SHA-256 over normalized event fields; source path/product label excluded; product version and sensor retained
processing_parameters.provenance: one canonical row per exact fingerprint; all source associations retained
